attempts.detail: Local here-document setup failed with ENOSPC. No numerical command ran.

A PTY paste truncated/corrupted the assertion line in the initial script; the file was replaced by the corrected source before any audit was run. The exact corrupted file bytes were not retained, so only the tool echo is available.

The first stable script used a mistyped parent layer-manifest SHA. The exact file digest was re-read, the script digest assertion corrected, and the audit then ran once. No partial layer output existed before the successful run.
Strict layer reader returned successfully for 1,728 paper rows on epsilon powers 10 through 24; 17.09320587478578 seconds; native_transactions=0.
